## Highlights since 0.16.4

- **Figures you can edit in their drawing program.** Paste a figure from a drawing program and Lattice stores its source and rendered files in `figures/`, inserts the `\input` and the packages it needs, and reopens the source in its program when you want to edit it. Drawings from Inkscape and draw.io (`.svg`, `.drawio`, `.dio`) become editable figures from the project tree, by paste or by drop, and re-render when the drawing changes: automatically in projects you trust, otherwise after you click Update figure. Thanks to @Paivel.
- **chemnum compound numbers in the PDF and the editor.** Hovering a compound number in the PDF shows its key, and clicking copies `\cmpd{key}`. Completion inside `\cmpd{` lists the project's compound keys with their numbers. Thanks to @Paivel.

## Notable fixes

- A comment highlight has the same colour in the `.tex` source and in the PDF.
- A root document in a subfolder finds the bibliography and other files at the project root, as on Overleaf, so citations no longer show as [?].
- When a build uses lineno 5.7, which draws CVPR review-mode line numbers over the text, Lattice says so and offers Update TeX packages. The TeX doctor checks for outdated packages once a day.
